correctness.rationale: Exact convolution integration gives p_beta(t)=2(1-sin t/t)(beta+t^-2), with positive symbol and limits 1/3 and 2beta. A continuous maximum of H(t) exists beyond 2pi; exact polynomial bounds locate beta_star in (1/6,9/50). Any global symbol maximum at beta_star occurs below 2pi, while its minimum is attained above 2pi and at t=0 in the limit. Comparing a fixed numerator/denominator pair proves strict global minimax uniqueness for beta<beta_star, and direct monotonicity handles beta>beta_star. Rigorous sine Taylor inequalities bound K(1/6)<=2 and an exact rational sine upper bound proves K(1/2)>4. The standalone check.py was run from its actual package preparation path and passed; finite grids are not the proof. Scope is uniform-over-periods ideal Fourier spectral condition numbers only.

value.rationale: Kernel-mass weighting is a motivated natural coefficient in a new nonlocal diffusion preconditioner. The theorem answers the associated exact parameter-selection problem uniformly over all periodic scales, proves uniqueness via a structural separation of spectral extrema, and shows a certified more-than-twofold condition-number improvement for the canonical admissible kernel. This is a substantively motivated failure of an intuitive mass-based tuning criterion, not a numerical recomputation of source tables. It supplies a baseline for future discrete or multikernel design, without claiming an iteration-count theorem.
